original_test_intent: Verify that OAM_4's complete static identity and inventory are correct and consistently surfaced through Redfish and BMC Web.
original_method: Resolve OAM_4 to its approved resource, authenticate over trusted TLS, validate stable identity/topology fields, and compare the entire normalized payload against both engineering expectations and the same Web object.
manual_activity: GPU/BMC owner confirms OAM_4-to-slot identity, expected values and Web mapping, then dispositions differences.
required_inputs: Canonical OAM_4 member and schema revision
TLS-trusted BMC and temporary read-only credential
safety_requirements: Authenticate server and exact OAM_4 member
Keep credentials out of process output and artifacts
Preserve additional and null properties for review
agent_execution_scope: Confirm identity and physical mapping before comparison
Generate a complete three-source field ledger
Escalate, rather than normalize away, discrepancies
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint, topology and expected properties
Own discrepancy disposition and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It targets OAM_4 but its trust bypasses, secret handling and unstructured dump are not valid acceptance evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query the authorized OAM_4 Redfish member with verified TLS and brokered credentials; bind it to the physical module and compare all fields to the approved baseline and concurrent Web view.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_4 scope, BMC-Web parity and the two five-minute source estimates remain explicit.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an OAM_4 identity/topology header followed by a complete expected/Redfish/Web property ledger, retaining raw hashes and timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authenticated collection, member binding and measurable completeness to the malformed one-line GET.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An OAM collection response is insufficient unless the OAM_4 member and physical location are proven.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Web labels may collapse vendor fields; explicit mapping is required rather than treating absence as equality.

project_override_considerations: Engineering owns the OAM_4 slot-to-resource association and vendor-extension policy; neither can be inferred from the numeric suffix alone.
expected_evidence: Same-object Web capture and label mapping
Difference decisions, access audit and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Although the URI contains a duplicated root, all semantic fields agree on OAM_4 static data and BMC-Web comparison.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing platform contract is a fulfillable prerequisite, so the case is not inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Adds physical-module binding and a testable completeness oracle for OAM_4 instead of trusting a similar-looking JSON object.
independent_technical_reasoning: The suffix `OAM_4` is not itself proof of physical position; firmware can reorder collection members or expose a stale object after replacement. Checking stable identifiers and the project topology map before comparing values prevents a syntactically successful query from validating the wrong accelerator. Vendor-extension labels also need an explicit UI mapping so missing fields remain visible.
